briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multi-agent AGI benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier intensified this week as OpenAI and Google released competing multi-agent systems while regulatory scrutiny on model exports increased. Funding remained robust with multiple $500M+ rounds closing in infrastructure and defense applications.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced multi-agent orchestration achieving 87% on new coordination benchmarks. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus while DeepSeek-V3.5 narrowed the gap on coding tasks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began volume production of 2nm AI chips for NVIDIA and AMD. Microsoft announced a $4B expansion of its Arizona data center campus dedicated to OpenAI workloads.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first publicly demonstrated 10x human-level multi-agent system emerge before or after 2028?
